name: openHop-Repeater
description: openHop Repeater is a browser-managed, MeshCore-compatible LoRa repeater. It supports native SX1262 SPI, CH341 USB-to-SPI, openHop TCP/USB modem, and KISS serial radio backends, with monitoring, MQTT, GPS, sensors, companion identities, and persistent runtime data. Choose the official main or dev image channel during installation.
